newsitem.title: USA: North America bunkers lower on cheap cargo prices.
newsitem.headline: North America bunkers lower on cheap cargo prices.

text.p: North American bunker prices were lower in moderate trade early this week, pressured down by cheap fuel cargo prices and oversupply, players said Tuesday.
The Gulf Coast was the hardest hit by oversupply and weak cargo prices which are currently at about 50 percent to crude.
Cargo prices usually run at levels 70 to 75 pct of crude oil values.
In Houston, spot 380 CST dropped $3 from last Thursday to between $88 a tonne and $90 a tonne. 180 CST was down $4 at $93/94, players said.
